meta.name: dask
meta.description: Distributed computing for larger-than-RAM pandas/NumPy workflows. Use when you need to scale existing pandas/NumPy code beyond memory or across clusters. Best for parallel file processing, distributed ML, integration with existing pandas code. For out-of-core analytics on single machine use vaex; for in-memory speed use polars.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 在集群上扩展 pandas 与 NumPy 的数据处理能力
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你的 pandas 代码因数据过大而内存溢出
copy.tagline_en: Scale your pandas and NumPy workflows across clusters
copy.fit_line_en: For you if your pandas code runs out of memory with large datasets

howto.what: 安装后,当你让 Claude 处理超大表格或数组时,它会用 Dask 库把数据拆分并行计算,支持比内存更大的数据,也能在多台机器上运行。Claude 会写出 Dask 代码并执行,产出计算结果。
howto.when: 当你要处理的数据超过电脑内存,或需要把 pandas/NumPy 代码并行化、在多台机器上运行时触发。也适用于并行读取多个 CSV/Parquet 文件等场景。

howto.what_en: When installed, Claude will use Dask to handle datasets larger than RAM by splitting work into parallel tasks, scaling pandas/NumPy workflows across cores or clusters, and computing results.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you need to process data exceeding available RAM, parallelize pandas/NumPy operations, or distribute workloads across multiple machines. Also for efficient multi-file reads (CSV, Parquet, etc.).
